title: Vendster: An Evaluation Arena to Investigate How Forecasting Tool Quality Affects LLM Agent Behaviors in Buyer-Vendor Negotiation

claim.summary: Vendster has two LLM agents negotiate per-product promotional discounts while the Buyer privately sees M5-grounded demand forecasts from ten model forecasters or a controlled bias and interval-width grid, measuring how forecast properties change sales-target attainment.

modules.name: Controlled forecast-quality negotiation arena
modules.scope_reason: Forecast bias and interval width are varied only as inputs to a fixed buyer-vendor discount negotiation scored by sales-target attainment, so the arena is bound to that decision contract.
